'''Repulsorcarts''' or '''repulsor carts''', short for '''repulsorlift carts''', were devices which could be loaded with various objects and then used to transport them. They used [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] to elevate themselves off the ground and would go into standby mode if not moved often enough which would result in the cart stopping. An elderly [[Unidentified elderly Chadra-Fan|Chadra-Fan]] used a repulsorcart which was in a poor state of repair to transport her luggage while traveling through [[Grand Terminal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feriae Junction/Legends|Junction]]. The cart's repulsors needed maintenance and regularly gave out, causing the device to drop to the floor. Whilst in the station the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] attempted to ascend a large set of stairs, resulting in the cart emitting a whining noise and then ceasing to work entirely two thirds of the way up the stairs.<ref name="ZT" />

==Behind the scenes==
A repulsorcart appeared in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Zygerrian Takedown]]'' which was released online by [[Wizards of the Coast]] and designed by [[Jason Fry]]. The adventure suggests that players could rent repulsorcarts and use them to transport a stunned [[Unidentified Bagman|courier]] that they need to capture, although players are free to use any method to try and subdue and move their target. A distraction for the heroes is later described involving a struggling elderly Chadra-Fan whom they can aid, although they are free to ignore her entirely.
